_comment: Copy to /data/announce.json (the mounted volume) to configure the Signal announcer without rebuilding. Env vars override these.

hosting._comment: One-shot invite, posted when the host presses the button.

score._comment: Final score line when a match ends.

archive._comment: Full replayable playout. Set a roomPattern to archive only some tables.

redacted._comment: Deal + result with names stripped to seat letters.
